messages:
sam: quick one 1 1 had an oncall flip an autofallback back to primary using the UI 'pin' and then we couldn't tell later if traffic was really primary or if metrics were being sampled differently. can we tighten the operator->audit->timeline surface?

izzy: yeah we're missing a clear, immutable transition for manual operator actions. right now it's just a flag on the rollout obj.

todd: agree. recommend treating operator overrides as explicit transitions in the rollout timeline (like 'auto->manual') with metadata: actor, reason, created_at, expires_at, source.

kai: UX: render a thin segment in the timeline bar with label "manual override by <actor> (ttl)", hover shows reason & link to full audit. add an obvious 'undo' button. microcopy: "Manual override will suppress autoswitches until expiry or emergency".

sam: re: emergency 1 what should bypass the override? SREs need a way to forcibly re-run autoswitch when things are catastrophic.

jordana: propose an "override-escape" set of absolute thresholds (configurable per rollout) that ignore cooldowns: defaults example: error_rate>0.25 OR p95>3s OR incident_flag=true. store those in the policy snapshot.

todd: telemetry change: emit a 'rollout_transition' event for all transitions (auto/manual/revert) with a replay_token and policy_snapshot_id. example payload (single-line JSON in event store):

{"rollout_transition":"type=override","actor":"sam","from":"fallback_v1","to":"primary","ttl":3600,"policy_snapshot_id":"ps-xyz","replay_token":"rt-1745678901"}

ops-bot: replay-token rt-1745678901 generated for rollout 1234.

izzy: storage: we can't keep full snapshots for every tiny change. plan: store compressed snapshot every N events (e.g., every 10) and store diffs otherwise, plus always persist a small canonical header (policy id, hash, replay_token).

sam: for the UI defaults: prefer 1h TTL by default, quick presets: 15m, 1h, 4h, indefinite (requires reason). require reason text when TTL>2h.

kai: also add a cooldown timer that prevents auto-fallbacks for the TTL period except for override-escape triggers. show countdown in timeline. add a small 'extend' dropdown inside the pill.

jordana: audit API: new endpoints: POST /api/rollouts/:id/overrides to create with body (actor, reason, ttl_seconds, require_audit) and POST /api/rollouts/:id/replay { replay_token } to run a replay in sandbox. include idempotency token.

todd: server validation: if ttl>7200 require non-empty reason and audit=true. will add 400 response if missing.

"The replay flow returns a deterministic decision path which the forensic tool can display."

izzy: small ops-safety ask: block UI from creating overlapping indefinite overrides without a secondary confirmation. ops-bot: note override-ux-confirmation requested.

sam: can we sample full snapshots for 1/20 transitions and always keep full snapshot for actions created by operators? that helps root cause.

jordana: yes let's always snapshot operator-triggered snapshots. diffs for autos. storage estimate needed from todd.

todd: will run numbers. action items: todd = storage & api estimate, kai = mock timeline + pill + extend UX, jordana = audit schema & replay API + example payloads, izzy = copy for microcopy & warnings. target: rough spec by Fri COB.

sam: thanks all. if anyone touches the UI or API, ping me before merging. :thumbsup:
